definition: Cold = no compiled output for the project (Java: module target/ removed; Rust: empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR). Java resolves prebuilt dependency jars from a populated local Maven repository; Rust compiles its crate dependencies from source, as every cold cargo build does. Compiled = tests re-run with nothing to rebuild. The same steps run on GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 runners in .github/workflows/metrics.yml.
